freeAidoDiscoverabilityCheck.name: AIDO Discoverability Check
freeAidoDiscoverabilityCheck.purpose: Show whether AI systems can access and understand a public business website, observe a small dated discovery sample, and optionally prepare and summarise a broader ten-question check in a compatible AI client.
checks: Public page reachability and crawl directives
How clearly public pages answer six business-specific customer questions
A bounded branded and unbranded AI-assisted search sample
An optional ten-question research pack that requires user agreement and does not itself run the searches
Clear separation between technical discoverability and commercial outcome evidence
doesNotProve: A fixed ChatGPT ranking, citation or recommendation
